profile.research_note:
Facility specific seeding pass 2026-09-02, batch 40 (Equinix missing-address campaign): added a five source agreeing aggregator address, flagged a single outlier aggregators differing city label rather than silently adopting or discarding it, research_status remains complete.

[batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] Equinix operates a very large global portfolio and this session found its own per-building pages under equinix.com/data-centers/ to be inconsistently populated: some individual IBX codes 404 entirely (confirmed fresh this session for DC17), and others that do load, such as DC7, checked fresh this session, still omit street address and square footage, deferring that detail to a downloadable specification sheet not reachable by this research pass. Given this, addresses in this batch rely on aggregator sourcing, preferring cases with independent multi source agreement, per this registrys standard source hierarchy. This specific row, SV6, per registry coordinates in Sunnyvale, CA. Multiple aggregators independently agree this facility sits at 444 Toyama Drive: Baxtel, UPSTACK, PeeringDB, datacenterHawk, and cloudandcolocation all describe it as Sunnyvale, matching this registrys own city field, five agreeing sources. One aggregator, DataCenterMap, gives the same street number but labels the city Santa Clara in its own page title, an apparent data quality mislabel on DataCenterMaps part given the weight of agreement elsewhere, flagged here rather than silently adopted.
sources_tried: Equinix own Silicon Valley metro index page, Baxtel, UPSTACK, PeeringDB, and datacenterHawk listings all specific to this building and agreeing on Sunnyvale, plus a DataCenterMap listing giving the same street number but a differing, likely mislabeled city
profile.regional_context: Per Equinix's own site, the Silicon Valley metro comprises 12 facilities (SV1-SV5, SV8, SV10-SV12x, SV14-SV16) described as the region's largest retail colocation footprint, serving over 10,500 customers including 4,900+ enterprises and 2,000+ network service providers.
profile.facility_type_note: Part of Equinix's Silicon Valley campus, spanning Santa Clara, San Jose (including the Great Oaks campus), Palo Alto, Sunnyvale, with a separate facility in Torrance in the Los Angeles area also grouped in this state.
